subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `bootstrapMaxChars` and `bootstrapTotalMaxChars` become writable through the model-facing Gateway config.apply/config.patch tool, or should this issue stay blocked until someone proves a current-main restart-deletion path?
rationale: Current source treats the keys as valid config, while the related source-reproducible behavior is a protected-path rejection at a model-to-operator trust boundary.

options.title: Require restart proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a current-main live Gateway restart/config snapshot reproduction before any allowlist or doctor change.

options.title: Approve narrow allowlist expansion
options.body: Allow only these bootstrap limit paths through the Gateway tool and require tests plus live config-write proof before merge.

options.title: Close as unsupported config-tool request
options.body: If maintainers decide agents should not tune these resource limits, close the protected-path portion while asking for a new issue if direct file config is still deleted.

recommendation.title: Require restart proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a current-main live Gateway restart/config snapshot reproduction before any allowlist or doctor change.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision most directly touches the Gateway agent config mutation guard lineage from their recent merged work.
